name: Oinam UI
description: A design system in plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript: custom elements for structure, native elements for the work, and no framework or build step.

components.name: wrap
components.title: Wrap
components.description: Centers the page content and keeps it off the edges.

components.name: stack
components.title: Stack
components.description: A column. Children sit one under the other, a gap apart.

components.name: row
components.title: Row
components.description: A row that wraps. Children sit side by side, a gap apart.

components.name: grid
components.title: Grid
components.description: Equal columns, as many as fit, with no breakpoints.

components.name: text
components.title: Text
components.description: A small label above a heading, and an opening paragraph a size up.

components.name: prose
components.title: Prose
components.description: A run of writing. Plain headings, paragraphs, and lists get their rhythm.

components.name: card
components.title: Card
components.description: Groups related things on a raised surface.

components.name: badge
components.title: Badge
components.description: A small label: a status, a count, a "new".

components.name: alert
components.title: Alert
components.description: Sets a message apart: a note, a warning, or danger.

components.name: table
components.title: Table
components.description: Frames a plain table and lets a wide one scroll sideways.

components.name: avatar
components.title: Avatar
components.description: A small round picture of someone, or their initials.

components.name: item
components.title: Item
components.description: One row in a list: something to know it by, a title and a line, and an action.

components.name: empty
components.title: Empty
components.description: Stands where content will be once there is some.

components.name: skeleton
components.title: Skeleton
components.description: Holds the place of something that is still loading.

components.name: spinner
components.title: Spinner
components.description: Says that something is under way.

components.name: progress
components.title: Progress
components.description: How far along something is, on a <progress>.

components.name: ratio
components.title: Ratio
components.description: Keeps a picture, a video, or a frame to a fixed shape.

components.name: scroll
components.title: Scroll
components.description: A frame for something too long to show at once.

components.name: button
components.title: Button
components.description: A button, on a <button> or an <a>.

components.name: button-group
components.title: Button group
components.description: Joins buttons that belong together into one piece.

components.name: field
components.title: Field
components.description: A label, its control, and a line of help, kept together.

components.name: input-group
components.title: Input group
components.description: Puts a unit, a prefix, or a button inside the frame of a field.

components.name: choice
components.title: Choice and switch
components.description: A checkbox, a radio button, or a switch, with its label.

components.name: slider
components.title: Slider
components.description: A value chosen by sliding, on an <input type="range">.

components.name: toggle
components.title: Toggle
components.description: A button that stays pressed, alone or in a group.

components.name: breadcrumb
components.title: Breadcrumb
components.description: Where this page sits, from the top down.

components.name: pagination
components.title: Pagination
components.description: Links to the pages of a long list.

components.name: accordion
components.title: Accordion
components.description: A set of <details> that open and close.

components.name: tabs
components.title: Tabs
components.description: Turns a run of sections into tabs.

components.name: dialog
components.title: Dialog
components.description: A modal or a drawer, on a <dialog>, opened and closed without script.

components.name: popover
components.title: Popover
components.description: A small panel that opens under the button that names it.

components.name: menu
components.title: Menu
components.description: A button and the short list of actions it opens.

components.name: tooltip
components.title: Tooltip
components.description: A few words about a control, on hover or focus.

components.name: copy
components.title: Copy
components.description: Adds a copy button to a block of code.

components.name: theme
components.title: Theme
components.description: A light and dark toggle that remembers the choice.

components.name: toast
components.title: Toast
components.description: Brief messages that appear in a corner and go away again.

components.name: example
components.title: Example
components.description: Shows markup at work and prints its source beside it.
